name: vix_regime_switch_5s_2
author: adapted from claude_strategist
thesis: India VIX mean-reverts after extreme readings. When VIX spikes above its 20-day Bollinger Band upper (> 2 SD), it signals peak fear, and Nifty50 stocks tend to bounce within 1-2 sessions. Conversely, when VIX drops below its lower band, complacency sets in and a correction follows. Intraday, you can exploit the transition by going long when VIX starts declining from a spike (buy fear) and short when VIX starts rising from a trough (sell complacency). Edge persists because most traders use VIX directionally rather than as a mean-reverting regime indicator.
mechanism: Market microstructure varies across volatility regimes. In low-vol regimes, mean-reversion dominates as market makers provide tight liquidity. In high-vol regimes, momentum persists as liquidity thins and stop-cascades amplify moves. Adapting the signal to the current regime captures the appropriate edge for prevailing conditions.

conditions: vix > vix_bb_upper (VIX is elevated — fear regime)
vix_change_60 < 0 (VIX starting to decline from peak)
vix < vix_bb_lower (VIX is depressed — complacency regime)
vix_change_60 > 0 (VIX starting to rise from trough)

exit.signal_exit: VIX reverses direction again (vix_change_60 flips sign)

filters.vix_filter: core to strategy — trade only when VIX is at extremes

weaknesses: Very low frequency — VIX extremes happen maybe 2-3 times per month; long idle periods
During genuine crises (COVID, geopolitical), VIX can stay elevated for weeks — mean reversion is delayed
High-beta stocks during VIX spikes have wide spreads and volatile fills — slippage is 4+ bps
prior_art: VIX mean reversion — well-documented in US markets (VXX trading). India VIX version is less studied.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
